title: Oracle bookmark marking step
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean word, let $f:\bbz\to\mathrm{Option}(\{0,1\})$ be a tape content, let $p\in\bbz$ be nonzero, choose a Boolean side, an input-head position, and an output word. One step of the oracle-dispatch machine from the configuration in bookmark state with tape $0$ equal to $f$, its other tapes initialized as specified by the local configuration, and the first two tape heads at $p$, produces the marked configuration: its state is the corresponding origin state, tape $0$ remains $f$, tape $1$ has its origin marker updated at $p$ to false, tape $2$ has the side marker at cell $0$, the first two heads remain at $p$, and the remaining heads, input-head position, and output are as specified.
hypotheses_covered: An input-head position for $x$ is given
caveat: The local and marked configurations are auxiliary encodings; the prose spells out their relevant tape and head contents.
